helpCenter.title: How OmniMon works
helpCenter.aboutBody: OmniMon delivers real-time system monitoring with network mapping, AI-powered analysis, security auditing, and browser tab management — all in a native desktop app.
helpCenter.aiActionsBody: Use this chat to ask about processes, tabs, memory, CPU, and to trigger supported actions like closing tabs. It is the action-oriented assistant.
helpCenter.aiConfigBody: Use this input to create alert rules or tweak app settings in natural language. It is for configuration, not for killing processes or tab actions.
helpCenter.alertRulesBody: Alert rules watch metrics like CPU, RAM, or process-specific usage. They trigger when the metric crosses the threshold you defined, and they show up in Alerts so you can review or remove them.
helpCenter.networkMapBody: Map groups live destinations by process so you can see which apps are talking to which hosts.
helpCenter.networkConnectionsBody: Connections lists the current destinations, ports, protocols, and states for the visible network telemetry.
helpCenter.networkTrafficBody: Traffic charts inbound and outbound throughput over time so you can spot spikes and sustained activity.
helpCenter.securityReportBody: Opens the security report and findings generated from process, CVE, and dynamic alert analysis.
helpCenter.dashboardBody: Shows or hides the dashboard cards at the top so you can focus on processes or bring charts back.
helpCenter.automationsBody: Opens the automation builder to create persistent monitoring rules that react when a process matches your thresholds.
helpCenter.settingsBody: Opens provider, model, API key, theme, language, and performance settings for the app.
helpCenter.fontBody: Increase or decrease font size for denser tables or more readable dashboards.
helpCenter.faqQ1: Why does the AI ask for confirmation?
helpCenter.faqA1: Destructive actions like closing tabs should be reviewed before execution so you can verify what will happen.
helpCenter.faqA2: If there is no recent traffic or the OS has not exposed enough telemetry yet, the network section may wait for real activity before showing data.
helpCenter.faqA3: Use AI Actions for system questions and actions, AI Config for settings and alert rules, and contextual chats inside panels when you want focused help.
